featured_reviews.name: rohan vaswani
featured_reviews.review_text:
My Experience with Piramal Group – Repeated Defaults on Written Commitments

I am sharing this purely as my personal experience and opinion, based on direct interactions with Piramal Group’s senior representatives.

I was given multiple explicit assurances, including a specific written commitment that a credit note would be issued by 8 February. That promise has now been missed, repeatedly, without explanation, ownership, or even basic communication—despite escalations to senior management.

When an organisation of this scale fails to honour simple, routine financial commitments after multiple follow-ups, it raises serious concerns about internal accountability, governance, and execution discipline. What is most worrying is not the delay itself, but the complete absence of transparency or ownership.

As a customer, this experience has significantly eroded my confidence. Repeated missed timelines and silence create the unfortunate perception that commitments are made casually and honoured selectively.

I would strongly advise prospective customers to document everything in writing, be cautious with assurances, and factor in delays—even when commitments are made at senior levels.

This review reflects my experience alone, but it has been deeply disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Rajkunwar Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointed with the After-Sales Experience

I would strongly advise against booking a property here. The after-sales service has been extremely poor, and the customer relationship management is frustrating to deal with. The CRM team seems to be trained only to follow up for payments and installations — any genuine customer concerns are consistently ignored.

We received an official invite claiming the amenities were completed and ready for viewing. We travelled from another city just for this, only to find that barely 10% of the amenities were ready — just two indoor rooms (Pilates & Cycling). This was highly misleading.

Despite making multiple visits — including two personal trips I made flying in from London — we have still not been shown the floor view of the completed building (South), even though that is a basic request. Our unit is in a different tower, but our only request was to see the floor view of a completed tower. Every time, we’ve been met with excuses like “we don’t have the keys” — even though possession hasn’t started yet.

The customer service is apathetic at best. Calls go unanswered, and emails regarding even simple customer requirements are ignored.

If this is the service before possession, it raises serious concerns about what can be expected after moving in.

Police petroling very frequent here. Other access is through Arthur road, 2 blocks from Arthur Rd. jail. So you can expect some disturbance on that.
3. Builder quotes: Please read each line on cost sheet very carefully. They've quoted different price everytime I visited. They'll push you for really unacceptable units in north tower. Review GST charges carefully. They know exactly where all they've messed up. So they'll only show higher floor in south tower to you.
4. Possible criminal activities in area: The SRA behind has 50+ units per floor and 40+ floors. These SRA units are already selling in black market. You can imagine what kind of people will buy these 400 sq. ft. units for a cr. Let me give you a hint, they're not going to be slum dweller. Still not clear? Read Saat rasta history.
Builder finish is good, but does not compensate for negatives. Worth waiting for OC so you can at least see what you're paying for in this strangely marketed/ located property. Mahalaxmi is good real estate micromarket, but avoid this property for sure.
